decision: Do CC's published decision guides expose primary evidence for factual, regulatory, privacy, and interoperability claims?
liveConsumer: Readers of the smart-thermostats, broadband-internet, and mobile-carriers guides, including their generated static guide pages.

gates.evidence: The founder directed Codex to begin Phase 3 on 2026-07-15.
A read-only scan found exactly three non-method published guides with zero external citations: smart-thermostats, broadband-internet, and mobile-carriers.

sourceRequirements: Current primary regulator, government-program, standards-owner, and first-party policy pages.
Direct support for energy-certification, broadband-label, location-data enforcement, CPNI, privacy-choice, coverage, and interoperability claims.
No source-count claim that substitutes citation quantity for evidence quality or editorial independence.

preconditions.evidence: Freshness and readiness audits found 24 of 25 curated categories presentation-ready; the only stale category is design-owned banking.
All three guide source files and the new audit path are clean. Generated static pages are deterministic pipeline outputs with inherited line-ending-only status noise and are not hand-edited.

doneWhen: Each of the three guides links directly to current primary evidence for its highest-consequence claims and shopping checks.
Every published non-method guide has at least one external citation under an executable audit.
The guide builder regenerates the three live static pages from source.
Guide voice, content readiness, and the repository verifier retain their pre-existing verdicts without a new Phase 3 regression.
A result card records evidence, limitations, and any inherited release blockers.
stopConditions: A source is merely a search result, affiliate review, unsourced ranking, or inaccessible citation target.
A citation would imply that certification, interoperability, or a privacy policy independently proves the product is safe or ethical.
The work would require editing design-owned methodology or banking guides.
A full dataset rebuild would apply the still-unintegrated Phase 2 provenance contract through inherited-dirty verification code.
expectedArtifacts: Three citation-deepened published guide sources and their generated static pages.
A frozen baseline and Phase 3 result card.

claimBoundary.supports: The three previously uncited published guides now expose current primary evidence, and future uncited published guides are detected.
claimBoundary.doesNotSupport: That link count proves accuracy, source independence, product quality, or complete geographic applicability.
